title: Workload on extensions/v1beta1, apps/v1beta1 or apps/v1beta2
basis: Removed in Kubernetes 1.16 - Deployment, DaemonSet, ReplicaSet and StatefulSet are served only by apps/v1

title: Ingress on extensions/v1beta1 or networking.k8s.io/v1beta1
basis: Removed in Kubernetes 1.22 - networking.k8s.io/v1, and the backend block changed shape

title: CustomResourceDefinition on apiextensions.k8s.io/v1beta1
basis: Removed in Kubernetes 1.22 - apiextensions.k8s.io/v1 requires a structural schema per version

title: Webhook, RBAC, CSR, Lease or PriorityClass on a v1beta1 group
basis: Removed in Kubernetes 1.22 - admissionregistration, rbac.authorization, certificates, coordination and scheduling are v1

title: storage.k8s.io/v1beta1 object
basis: Removed in Kubernetes 1.22, and CSIStorageCapacity in 1.27 - storage.k8s.io/v1

title: PodDisruptionBudget on policy/v1beta1
basis: Removed in Kubernetes 1.25 - policy/v1, where an empty selector now selects no pods

title: PodSecurityPolicy
basis: Removed outright in Kubernetes 1.25 - replaced by Pod Security Admission namespace labels

title: Event, EndpointSlice or RuntimeClass on a v1beta1 group
basis: Removed in Kubernetes 1.25 - events.k8s.io/v1, discovery.k8s.io/v1, node.k8s.io/v1

title: FlowSchema or PriorityLevelConfiguration on a beta group
apps/v1 workload with no spec.selector
basis: apps/v1 makes spec.selector required and immutable; extensions/v1beta1 defaulted it from the pod labels

title: kubernetes.io/ingress.class annotation
basis: Deprecated with the v1beta1 Ingress - networking.k8s.io/v1 uses spec.ingressClassName

title: beta.kubernetes.io or failure-domain.beta.kubernetes.io node label
basis: Deprecated node labels - kubernetes.io/os, kubernetes.io/arch, topology.kubernetes.io/zone, node.kubernetes.io/instance-type

title: seccomp or critical-pod alpha annotation
basis: The seccomp alpha annotations stopped being honoured in Kubernetes 1.25 and critical-pod went in 1.16 - securityContext.seccompProfile and priorityClassName
